ascidians text index | photo index Phylum Chordata | Subphylum Tunicata/Urochordata | Class Ascidiacea Orange-spotted ascidians
awaiting identification*updated Mar 2020

Where seen? These small blobs with bright orange spots are sometimes seen on some of our shores.

Features: Colony about 5-8cm in diameter. Rubbery blobs found near seagrasses. Dark blue background with bright orange spots arranged in petal-like shapes.


Sentosa, Nov 11**


Cyrene Reef, Jun 12**

***Species are difficult to positively identify without examination of internal parts.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
